Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., “slightly”). - Include key predicate-argument structure and modifier attachment/scope (what modifies what) when it affects meaning. - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita. Reference Translation (provided): Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed.

**(a) Interpretation Lock FIRST – one bullet per source line**
- **Line 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita** ⇒ **Locked Meaning** *There exists a point that is the middle (mezzo) of the journey (cammin) that belongs to our life (nostra vita). At that point the speaker is situated.* - Predicate‑argument structure: **midpoint( X , journey_of(our_life) )** - Modifier scope: *mezzo* modifies *cammin*; *nostra* modifies *vita*; the prepositional phrase *del cammin di nostra vita* forms the domain of the midpoint.
- **Line 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,** ⇒ **Locked Meaning** *The speaker (mi) discovers himself (ritrovai) located inside (per) a dark forest (una selva oscura).* - Predicate‑argument structure: **find_self( speaker , location = dark_forest )** - Modifier scope: *oscura* modifies *selva*; the prepositional phrase *per una selva oscura* specifies the location of the self‑finding event.
- **Line 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita.** ⇒ **Locked Meaning** *Because (ché) the correct way (la diritta via) was in a state of having been missed (era smarrita), the preceding situation obtains.* - Predicate‑argument structure: **missed( right_way )** with causal link **because(missed(right_way), …)** - Modifier scope: *diritta* modifies *via*; *smarrita* is a past‑participle adjective predicating the state of *via*.
